title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening global health resilience in partner countries
part_text: 17.Calls for the EU and its Member States to address health disparities, with particular emphasis on the protection of mothers and children, maternal healthcare, prenatal and postnatal care, and the prevention of maternal mortality and sex-based violence; stresses that EU funding must not be used to finance or promote abortion, while respecting partner countries’ competencies and national contexts and remaining consistent with international human rights commitments;
